Independent SOC lab

Turning telemetry into investigation practice.

Personal lab work complements my professional operations experience. These exercises are learning projects, not production SOC engagements.

Authentication · Splunk

SSH failed-login analysis

Collected Linux authentication logs in Splunk and developed a search that groups repeated failures by source IP, host, and five-minute window.

Investigation focus: targeted accounts, successful logins after failures, and the evidence needed for escalation.

View detection approach
index=* "Failed password"
| rex field=_raw "from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})"
| where isnotnull(src_ip)
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count as failed_events by _time src_ip host
| where failed_events >= 5

Lab starting point: scope the index and source, validate field extraction, and tune thresholds for the environment. Failures alone do not prove compromise.
